## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For UI changes, include the interaction tested and desktop/mobile screenshots where useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant checks pass (`npm run check`, build, and browser tests for UI changes).
- [ ] Documentation and translations are updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] Tokens, cookies, private data, and generated test artifacts are excluded.
- [ ] Any added third-party material has its source and license recorded.
